entries.headline: Helldivers 2’s Scope of Authority Premium Warbond launches October 20
entries.summary: Arrowhead announced the Scope of Authority Premium Warbond for Helldivers 2, focused on long-range and clandestine combat with gear including the R-40 Sightliner bolt-action sniper rifle and AMW-20 Apex anti-materiel rifle.
entries.verification: An opened first-party PlayStation Blog post confirms the Warbond name, launch date, and highlighted equipment.

entries.headline: Valor Mortis is now available on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, and Game Pass
entries.summary: One More Level’s soulslike action game Valor Mortis is now available on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, and Game Pass, with Xbox Play Anywhere support.
entries.verification: An opened first-party Xbox Wire article explicitly confirms availability, platforms, Game Pass, and Xbox Play Anywhere support.

entries.headline: Dyping Working: 作業監視ゲーム announced for Steam in 2027
entries.summary: PLAYISM announced Dyping Working: 作業監視ゲーム, a Dyping spin-off from Heaviside Creations in which an on-screen eye monitors the player’s work. It is planned for PC via Steam in 2027.
entries.verification: Two opened media reports independently match on the developer, platform, and 2027 release window; one reproduces PLAYISM’s announcement text.

entries.headline: Bless You Again demo launches on Steam
entries.summary: Gino released a Steam demo for Bless You Again, featuring two of five playable characters and its melee-to-magic roguelite loop. The full game is planned for 2026.
entries.verification: Two opened media reports independently confirm the demo launch, Steam platform, and 2026 window for the full game.

entries.headline: Monster Farm Advance and two other GBA games join Nintendo Classics
entries.summary: Nintendo added Kuru Kuru Kururin Paradise, Metal Slug Advance, and Monster Farm Advance to Game Boy Advance – Nintendo Classics for Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack members.
entries.verification: An opened trusted media report clearly relays Nintendo’s October 14 release, the three games, and the membership requirement; the packet does not include a readable matching Nintendo detail page.

entries.headline: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve: Ace Combat 8’s Steam preorder bonus ACE COMBAT ZERO is getting a standalone app
entries.summary: Bandai Namco says it is preparing a separately installable and launchable app for the Steam preorder-bonus version of ACE COMBAT ZERO. It will be limited to players who already own the preorder bonus, and no release date has been announced.
entries.verification: An opened trusted media report clearly relays Bandai Namco’s October 13 notice, including the standalone-app plan, eligibility limit, and unannounced timing.
